interpretation_limit: The four non-control changes remove polite framing only and change separators. This set does not establish broad narrative normalization. Semantic information was not compressed.

cases.raw_task: Could you help with this investigation? Help me distinguish throttling, an out-of-memory limit, and memory protection when investigating a latency regression. The affected inference service runs in a Linux memory cgroup, and I can collect host-memory pressure and event counters for that group and its children. Give a diagnostic plan that separates local events from child activity and considers pressure on sibling workloads; explain the limits of any protection guarantee, but do not change settings or claim a measured improvement.

cases.raw_task: Please help me review this. Prepare a correctness review for replaying a captured graph with a new input and identify what a diagnostic reproduction could and could not establish. The component is a vLLM-Ascend graph wrapper, and the call can contain positional tensors as well as nested or keyword inputs. Check who is responsible for input storage and updates, include lifetime and ordering concerns, and keep this source-based rather than claiming installed-stack compatibility; do not run the reproduction or trade correctness checks for a better timing.

cases.raw_task: Could you advise on this memory issue? Propose how to investigate retained host RAM from large, rarely reused pinned buffers and decide which allocator options are relevant. The workload uses TorchNPU, and we have not yet verified the installed versions or whether pin_memory_expandable_segments=True is active. First establish the applicable version and allocator-path gates, describe the trade-offs of any proposed settings in fresh-process trials, and distinguish host allocation from device memory; do not run trials, promise a total-cache quota, or free buffers that are still in flight.

cases.raw_task: Please help me check this download. Explain how to tell whether a sharded model download is complete and how to recover only what is missing. The download directory contains numbered safetensors shards, an index JSON, and some .incomplete marker files. Base the assessment on shard structure and the index rather than assuming the markers prove corruption; describe a bounded-concurrency recovery plan without downloading anything, and do not treat structural completeness as proof of tensor correctness or model quality.
